scenes.text: Your AI coding agent does something different every single time. Archon changes that.

Archon is an open-source workflow engine — YAML files that define every phase of AI-assisted coding: planning, implementation, validation, and PR creation. Think Dockerfiles for AI coding. Same workflow, same sequence, every run.

Mix deterministic bash steps with AI-powered nodes. Choose from 17 built-in workflows — issue fixing, PR review, feature development, and more. Trigger from CLI, Slack, Discord, Telegram, or GitHub webhooks.
MIT licensed. No lock-in. Install in 30 seconds at archon.diy.
